bins.name: Recycle
bins.rules: Clean paper, cardboard, metal cans, glass bottles and jars, and rigid plastics marked recyclable. Must be empty, clean, and dry.

bins.name: Compost / Organics
bins.rules: Food scraps, food-soiled paper and cardboard, coffee grounds, and yard trimmings. No plastics, glass, or metal.

bins.name: Landfill
bins.rules: Anything that fits no other bin: chip bags, candy wrappers, styrofoam, broken ceramics, and other non-recyclable, non-compostable waste.

bins.name: Hazardous / Special
bins.rules: Batteries, electronics, paint, chemicals, light bulbs, and medical waste. These need a drop-off point, never a curbside can.
